description.en: SkillVetBench is a two-stage security vetting benchmark for open agentic skill ecosystems, evaluating detection of malicious skills via semantic analysis and runtime verification in a sandbox. The benchmark is built from confirmed malicious skills in the OpenClaw ecosystem.

claire_radar.whyItMatters: Open agent platforms face supply-chain risks from malicious skills, but existing defenses lack a standardized evaluation. This benchmark addresses the gap in measuring both detection and runtime verification, offering practical value for improving security in agent ecosystems.
